claim: For the four-mode state \( |M_t\rangle=(|0000\rangle+t|1111\rangle)/\sqrt{1+t^2} \), \(0<t\le1\), in the weighted-Gram exponent of arXiv:2610.02172v1 let \(\theta_t=t^2/(1+t^2)\), \(N_t=\exp(h(\theta_t))\), and restrict the source entropy maximization to the natural face \(w_3=0\). Writing \(D_t=\sqrt{(11N_t-8)/(3N_t)}\) and \(r_t=(D_t-1)/2\), the restricted optimum is exactly \[\widehat B_t=\frac{1+4N_t r_t+3N_t r_t^2}{(1+r_t)^4}=\frac{8(3N_t-2+N_tD_t)}{(1+D_t)^4}>1,\] with unique optimizing weights proportional to \( (1,4N_t r_t,3N_t r_t^2,0) \). Hence the full source base obeys \(B_t\ge\widehat B_t\), so for every fixed \(0\le\delta<1\), \[\liminf_{k\to\infty}\frac1k\log \underline\chi_{\mathrm G}^{(\delta)}(|M_t\rangle^{\otimes k})\ge\log\widehat B_t.\] Moreover, as \(t\to0\), \[\log\widehat B_t=\frac43 h(\theta_t)^2+O(h(\theta_t)^3)\sim\frac{16}{3}t^4\log^2(1/t).\] This supplies an explicit analytic exponential-rank certificate and its near-Gaussian collapse law without solving the source's full three-parameter maximization.
integrity: The proof reconstructs the face Gram spectrum, entropy, Gibbs variational step, self-consistent stationary point, uniqueness, and small-entropy expansion analytically. The bundled finite computation is corroborative only. Primary-source inspection distinguishes the source qualitative positivity argument from the closed-form face optimum claimed here.
scientific_limitations: The result exactly optimizes only the structurally natural face \(w_3=0\) of the source variational problem. It gives a rigorous lower certificate for the full exponent base but does not claim global optimality of that face or the exact small-\(t\) asymptotic of the full \(B_t\).
title: Closed-form face exponent for four-mode fermionic Gaussian rank
